Myth-Busting Summary: The infamous "Q33NY" claims that entering this flight number in Wingdings shows an airplane hitting twin tower symbols followed by a skull crossbones. However, neither plane involved in the September 11 attacks had this tail or flight designation. The sequence was deliberately fabricated to exploit character mapping configurations after the event.
